candidates.name: action_syntax_normalization
candidates.hypothesis: Normalizing natural language placement commands ('put/place <obj> in/on/in/on/into/onto <recep>') to ALFWorld's accepted syntax ('move <obj> to <recep>') in tool_policy.parse will eliminate 2-4 wasted steps and redundant admissible_commands calls per episode, preventing step budget exhaustion on complex multi-object tasks and reducing average turns and tokens by 15-20%.
candidates.changes: In variants/tool_policy/default.py, implement command syntax normalization for text-game actions in parse(), mapping 'put/place <obj> in/on/into/onto <recep>' to 'move <obj> to <recep>'.
candidates.expected_efficiency: Reduces mean turns from 11.4 to ~9.2 and saves ~15-20% input tokens across all placement tasks.
